name.en: The Unstoppable Love Train! Anna Kaboom

notes: The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over the course of the event:

rows.text: Card Sleeves: The Unstoppable Love Train! Anna Kaboom
Game Mat: The Unstoppable Love Train! Anna Kaboom
Title: The Unstoppable Love Train! Anna Kaboom Completed

notes: When Dueling against Anna Kaboom at Level 40 or higher, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.
Possessed Duelists possess the same rewards, but since they only spawn at Level 20, cards from the standard pool may also drop.

rows.text: “Heavy Armored Train Ironwolf”, "Night Express Knight", "Express Train Trolley Olley"

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remains open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
These missions were available from the start of the event.
The following missions were added on February 26, 2022.

rows.text: Win 1 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom at Level 10 in Duel World.
Win 1 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom at Level 20 in Duel World.
Win 1 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom at Level 30 in Duel World.
Win 1 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom at Level 40 in Duel World.
Win 20 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom in Duel World.
Win 40 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom in Duel World.
Play 30 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom in Duel World.
Play 60 Duel(s) against Anna Kaboom in Duel World.
Summon "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max" 1 time(s) while playing as Anna Kaboom.
Summon "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max" 2 time(s) while playing as Anna Kaboom.
Summon "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max" 3 time(s) while playing as Anna Kaboom.
Win by reducing your opponent's LP to 0 by inflicting effect or battle damage with "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max" using Anna Kaboom.
Play 1 Duel(s) in Ranked Duels (surrenders are not counted).
Play 2 Duel(s) in Ranked Duels (surrenders are not counted).
Play 3 Duel(s) in Ranked Duels (surrenders are not counted).
